books in canonical order, evenly spaced (not to scale) · only the chapters gathered so far
FORTY DAYS · filled = “and forty nights” (22 verses)
Hebrew: Westminster Leningrad Codex (public domain), via Sefaria. Greek verses are references only:
they were checked privately against Codex Sinaiticus, whose transcription may not be republished.
Counts and letters are literal and rerunnable; what they mean is reading, and stays open.
